maria: Quick sync — roundtable rehearsal tomorrow 10:00am PT. Need to lock run-of-show and final speaker order. Also finalizing the LLM demo prompts, can we confirm?

devon: yes, 10 works for me. can we add a 5min buffer after the demo for live q's?

aj: +1 on buffer. I still need to confirm my slides but demo code is ready. will bring a short fallback video in case live model latency spikes. :movie_camera:

sophie: I can move my segment earlier by 3 mins to give Aj more time. also, let's make sure we test: cold start + high concurrency path.

maria: perfect. agenda so far: 1) intro 2) benchmark quick hits 3) roundtable 4) live demo 5) Q&A. Aj demo should be #4.

devon: for benchmark quick hits, can someone paste the 99th percentile latency numbers we'll call out? I want to avoid exact microsecond claims.

aj: draft line: "99th percentile tail latency under load remains < 350ms on Dedicated config during our test harness." can tweak wording.

sophie: sounds safe. also call out fallback policy: "automatic region fallback and model-variant degrade path" so customers know reliability story.

maria: good. on prompts: aj, can you paste the prompt set you'll run so marketing can craft the slide copy? we need 3 example inputs and 1 adversarial prompt.

aj: posting prompt snippet: ```
# Demo prompt set
1) "Summarize infra runbook for: sudden traffic spike, 20% error rate"
2) "Rewrite this product blurb for developer audience: <short blurb>"
3) "Generate safe-by-default chat response that asks clarifying Qs for ambiguous legal queries"
# Adversarial
4) Long-streaming input: repeat 8K tokens of lorem + rate of short queries
```

maria: perfect. marketing will draft slides using those. please keep those exact strings; we'll run them in dry-run.

deploy-bot: rehearsal reminder created for 5278902000. 2 reminders: 30m and 5m prior.

devon: quick ops checklist for dry-run: 
- confirm model pinned version
- enable KV cache warmup
- set autoscale to capped burst for demo
- set routing policy to prefer Dedicated then Hosted fallback

aj: noted, I'll send a short runbook with commands. example warmup command: ```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/engines/demo/requests \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -d '{"input":"warmup token stream", "count":20}'
```

sophie: thanks. can marketing create one slide that explains the fallback in plain english (1-liner + small diagram)? I'll help with the diagram quick notes.

maria: yes — I'll make that slide and share before EOD. final ask: everyone react with :thumbsup: once you've confirmed availability and the prompt list.

aj: :thumbsup:

devon: :thumbsup:

sophie: :thumbsup:

maria: awesome, see you tomorrow.
